design_note: Implements ось C (Axis C) from extensibility-and-authoring.md §8: a physically isolated contour is a RARE on-demand escalation expressed as a config-flip over the same single artifact — NOT the default and NOT a fork. The default remains two logical tiers (draft→published) in one silo (T-0087). The seam is a boolean flag `physical_isolation_requested` on choros.tenant (default false). Setting it true signals escalation intent; actual infra provisioning is human-gated (GT-4, deploy-time, founder-gated). The flag is reversible (flip back to false re-enters logical-tier mode). Agents cannot flip the flag (human-gate). No data is copied on flip.

how_it_extends_T0087.t0088_adds: The ось-C escalation seam ON TOP of the default logical model. A flag on the tenant root (not on the artifact) signals that this tenant has been escalated to a physically isolated contour. The logical tier model (T-0087) remains fully active in both states — the physical contour is an additive operational concern layered over it.
how_it_extends_T0087.logical_default_preserved: physical_isolation_requested defaults to false; all existing tenants remain in logical-tier mode with zero migration side-effects.
how_it_extends_T0087.reversible: decideIsolationEscalation has both 'escalate' (false→true) and 'deescalate' (true→false) branches; no data is lost by the flip.
